header.title: Your order
header.intro: Tell me briefly what you're looking for. I review your request personally and send you a quote. You don't need an account.

leave.title: Leave this page?
leave.body: Your order hasn't been sent yet. If you leave now, the details and photos you added will be lost.

inspiration.banner: You're starting from the work ‘{{title}}’. It's attached as a reference and its category is selected.
inspiration.bannerNoCategory: You're starting from the work ‘{{title}}’. It's attached as a reference.
inspiration.unavailable: This work is not (or no longer) available as an example. You can simply continue without it.

form.categoriesError: The categories could not be loaded. You can describe your wish below.
form.sizeHint: Example: 30 × 40 cm. An estimate is fine.
form.descriptionHint: Colours, style, subject, idea … At least {{minDescription}} characters.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: For example: a calm landscape in soft blues to hang above the sofa.
form.emailHint: Optional. We'll then also email you the private link and updates.
form.addressHint: Where will the work go? This can differ from your own address.
form.privacy: I have read the privacy policy and agree to my data being processed for this order.
form.noCharge: You don't pay anything now. I'll review your request and send you a personal quote.

photos.drop: or drag and drop them here
photos.limits: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to {{maxFiles}} photos · max. {{maxSizeMb}} MB per file
photos.tooMany: You can only add {{remaining}} more photo(s); {{skipped}} file(s) were not added.

confirmation.title: Thank you for your order
confirmation.next2: If I have questions, I'll send you a message. You read and answer it through your private link.
confirmation.next3: You receive a personal quote. You decide, without obligation, whether to go ahead.

sent.linkIntro: With this link you can follow your order and send me messages. You don't need an account or password.
sent.copyManually: Copying didn't work automatically. The link is selected — please copy it yourself.
sent.saveWarningBody: Only with this link can you find your order again later. Don't share it with anyone. It is valid until {{date}}.
sent.emailed: We also sent the link to {{email}}.
sent.missingTitle: This page is no longer available
sent.missingBody: The confirmation is shown only once. Use the private link you saved, or get in touch.

track.title: Your order
track.keepLink: Bookmark this page: only this link opens your order.
track.invalidBody: The link is incomplete, expired or replaced by a new one. Get in touch if you need a new link.
